name: @irudd-le/overlay
description: The Last Epoch passive content-shell Electron overlay
author: Andreas Lundgren

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @irudd-le/protocol build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @irudd-le/protocol build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build && node --test build/main/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev: nodemon --quiet --watch src --ext ts,html,css --exec "corepack pnpm build && electron ."
